items.comment: Summary sentence and all 19 @tparam entries plus @tparam R are accurate given the empty class body (extends Function19 only) and correctly ordered ordinals. Style matches the established AbstractFunction1 pattern: declarative first sentence, wiki-style [[scala.Function19]] link, lowercase/no-period tag continuations.

bonus_findings.note: Sibling files AbstractFunction15-18 use a different phrasing convention: a two-paragraph form ('`AbstractFunctionN` is a base class for ... implementations.' / 'Extending this class allows ...') and describe @tparam R as 'the return type of this function', whereas this file (and AbstractFunction1) use a single-paragraph form and 'the result type of the function'. Not inaccurate, but the AbstractFunctionN family is inconsistent across files. Pre-existing pattern split, not introduced by this diff.
